categories.main_business_segments: THN Corporation primarily operates in the automotive parts industry, specializing in the manufacturing and sale of wire harnesses for vehicles. The company and its subsidiaries focus exclusively on automotive electrical components, serving mainly the Hyundai Kia Automotive Group and other global automakers. It operates as a single business segment centered on automotive wire harness production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced wire harness design and manufacturing technologies, including CATIA system for parts design and collaboration with partners like Furukawa Electric for junction block development. Production involves labor-intensive processes optimized through overseas manufacturing bases in China and Southeast Asia to leverage cost efficiencies. R&D focuses on high-voltage junction blocks, power control modules for autonomous vehicles, and integrated communication controllers for electric and autonomous vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: THN's primary customers are major automotive manufacturers, especially Hyundai Motor Company and Kia Motors, including their related affiliates like Hyundai Mobis. The company serves both domestic and international automotive markets, supplying wire harnesses for various vehicle models including electric and autonomous vehicles. Its products are sold mainly to OEMs in South Korea and overseas markets such as Brazil, Paraguay, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Mexico.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities and subsidiaries in South Korea, China (multiple locations), Brazil, Paraguay, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Mexico. Its sales and production footprint covers domestic Korean markets and significant export markets in the Americas and Asia, supporting global automotive OEMs. The geographic diversification supports cost-effective production and proximity to key customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: THN Corporation operates primarily as a Tier 1 automotive parts supplier, positioned midstream in the automotive supply chain. It manufactures and supplies wire harnesses directly to major automakers during vehicle production. The company does not engage in raw material extraction but procures key inputs like wire, housing, terminals, and grommets from specialized suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in next-generation automotive electrical components aligned with trends in electrification, autonomous driving, and connectivity. Key initiatives include developing high-voltage junction blocks, power control modules for autonomous vehicles, integrated communication controllers, and large-capacity charging systems for electric vehicles. THN collaborates with Hyundai Motor Company and research institutes to innovate and secure new vehicle platform supply contracts.
categories.revenue_model: THN generates revenue primarily through the sale of automotive wire harness products to OEM customers under long-term supply arrangements. Revenue is derived from both domestic and export sales, with approximately 70% from exports. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales and related services such as technical support and after-sales service.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Within the domestic Korean market, THN is one of three primary Tier 1 wire harness suppliers to Hyundai Motor Company, holding around 11.3% market share. Competitors include Kyungshin Industrial and Yura Corporation, which have larger shares. THN is recognized for its technological capabilities and is positioned as a leading specialized automotive parts manufacturer with a strong relationship with Hyundai Kia Group.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, THN reported consolidated revenues of approximately 586 billion KRW, marking a 24.8% increase year-over-year and achieving its highest sales in history. The company’s total assets stood at about 4 trillion KRW with equity of 1.18 trillion KRW, reflecting a 29.3% equity ratio. Profitability improved significantly with operating income rising over 37 times compared to the previous year, driven by increased production and sales volume.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: THN offers high-quality, reliable wire harness products tailored to the needs of leading global automakers, emphasizing technological innovation and supply stability. Its competitive advantages include advanced R&D capabilities in electrification and autonomous vehicle components, strong customer partnerships, and a global manufacturing footprint that ensures cost competitiveness and timely delivery. The company also focuses on quality certifications and continuous process improvements to meet stringent automotive standards.
